goal: Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers to trace a Sling request from URL to resolved Resource, request information, resource type hierarchy, selected script or servlet and response using observable evidence.

deck_context.source_summary: Class 4 of a seven-week AEM Sites training course, delivered Thursday, August 20, 2026. The audience already knows JCR nodes, properties, Sling Resources and the responsibilities of /content, /conf and /apps. This class focuses on the resource-first Sling request model, URL decomposition after resource resolution, resource types, super types and handler selection. Supplied evidence can replace a live environment.
deck_context.core_claim: A reliable Sling request trace follows evidence in order: request URL and method, resolved Resource, RequestPathInfo, resource type hierarchy, selected handler and response.

style.name: 技术图谱课件风
style.visual_direction: Sober, information-rich technical atlas blended with academic courseware. Use exact request values, paths, properties, candidate labels and meaningful connectors rather than generic corporate cards.
style.color_palette: Warm ivory drafting-paper background, deep navy typography, faint square grid, blue for request and Resource evidence, green for resolution or properties, violet for component code and inheritance, restrained slate for neutral metadata.
style.typography: Large bold modern sans serif headings; crisp sans serif body copy; true monospace appearance for URLs, paths, properties, methods, types and handler names.
style.texture_and_finish: Flat 2D technical diagrams with fine rules, restrained headers, precise folder, request, resource and code icons. No gradients, neon, glass, 3D or photography.
style.deck_consistency: Match the approved sample's palette, typography, grid, density, semantic colors, evidence tags and line weight while varying the composition by slide role.

approved_style_reference.fidelity: Match palette, typography, grid, annotation density, evidence-tag language and technical precision only; do not copy the exact six-checkpoint layout.

slides.title: Follow the request, not a guess.
slides.intent: Open with the evidence chain used to explain every Sling request in the session.
key_points: Class 4 · Week 1 · Day 4 · August 20, 2026
How Sling resolves a request
URL → resource → resource type → script or servlet → response
Juan Maldonado

local_context.required_background: The audience already understands Sling Resources. The outcome is to justify each resolution transition with an observable request value, path or property.

layout.composition: Editorial opener with one browser request entering a five-checkpoint technical path and a dark evidence-chain footer.
layout.intent: Make the ordered request trace memorable without using a generic title-only cover.

visual_elements.main_visual: Browser URL flowing through Resource, resource type, handler and HTML response checkpoints.

constraints: Render all class metadata exactly.
Keep the cover detailed but projection-readable.
Do not imply that rendering code is selected before the Resource.

slides.title: Sling resolves a Resource before rendering code.
slides.intent: Replace a controller-route-first assumption with Sling's resource-first request model.
key_points: Resolve the request URI against the resource tree
The resolved Resource becomes the subject of the request
Its resource type guides script or servlet selection
Select rendering code only after resource resolution

local_context.required_background: The sequence is request URI → ResourceResolver → Resource → resource type → servlet or script → response. Make Resource the dominant checkpoint.

layout.composition: A left-to-right pipeline with a large central Resource card, contrasted against a crossed-out controller-route-first shortcut.
layout.intent: Explain order and dependency rather than show equal independent cards.

visual_elements.main_visual: Ordered request-processing pipeline with evidence labels at each arrow.

constraints: Render the eyebrow exactly as '02 · RESOURCE FIRST'.
Use Resource and ResourceResolver precisely.
Do not claim that the URL directly selects an HTL file.

slides.title: The resource path determines URL decomposition.
slides.intent: Teach RequestPathInfo using one exact request and the longest resolvable resource-path boundary.
key_points: Request: /content/wknd/us/en/guide.print.a4.html/chapter-1
Resource path: /content/wknd/us/en/guide
Selectors: print.a4
Extension: html
Suffix: /chapter-1

local_context.required_background: Assume /content/wknd/us/en/guide exists. The resource path is the longest resolvable match. HTTP method is separate and must not be presented as a RequestPathInfo field.

layout.composition: Large URL ruler segmented by semantic color, with a RequestPathInfo inspector and a longest-existing-match callout.
layout.intent: Make the parsing boundary visible and warn against splitting at the first dot.

visual_elements.main_visual: Color-coded URL anatomy with exact labels for resource path, selectors, extension and suffix.

constraints: Render the eyebrow exactly as '03 · URL ANATOMY'.
Render every URL segment exactly.
State that the resource path is the longest resolvable match.
Do not include HTTP method inside RequestPathInfo.

slides.title: sling:resourceType names rendering capability.
slides.intent: Connect a content Resource to project component implementation without merging their ownership or paths.
key_points: The property belongs to the resolved content Resource
sling:resourceType = wknd/components/guide
Relative resource types are resolved through Sling search paths
Project implementation: /apps/wknd/components/guide
Content and implementation remain separate

local_context.required_background: Use a component instance at /content/wknd/us/en/guide/jcr:content/root/container/guide. The resource type value is relative and maps to project capability under /apps; it is not an absolute repository path stored on content.

layout.composition: Content Resource inspector on the left, exact property bridge in the center and project component tree under /apps on the right.
layout.intent: Show the property as the explicit connection while preserving lifecycle boundaries.

visual_elements.main_visual: A selected content Resource connected by a property tag to a component tree.

constraints: Render the eyebrow exactly as '04 · RESOURCE TYPE'.
Render sling:resourceType and both paths exactly.
Do not show the property value with a leading /apps prefix.

slides.title: Resource super types delegate instead of copying.
slides.intent: Explain resource type inheritance and the proxy-component reuse pattern.
key_points: A project component can declare sling:resourceSuperType
Resolution can continue through the resource type hierarchy
A proxy inherits Core Component behavior
The project owns only its configuration and deliberate overrides
Do not copy the parent implementation

local_context.required_background: Use project type wknd/components/guide and example super type core/wcm/components/teaser/v2/teaser. Show a narrow direct override and inherited behavior separately.

layout.composition: Vertical inheritance ladder from content Resource to project proxy to Core Component capability, with inherited and overridden areas visually separated.
layout.intent: Make delegation and fallback visible without implying code duplication.

visual_elements.main_visual: A resource-type hierarchy with one narrow project override and a larger inherited capability block.

constraints: Render the eyebrow exactly as '05 · RESOURCE TYPE INHERITANCE'.
Render sling:resourceSuperType and both type values exactly.
Do not show copied files from the Core Component.

slides.title: Request details narrow the handler candidates.
slides.intent: Explain how resource type hierarchy, selectors, extension and HTTP method participate in servlet or script resolution.
key_points: Resource type and its hierarchy define where Sling looks
Selectors and extension describe the representation
HTTP method distinguishes request handling behavior
The most specific matching candidate wins
Fallback continues through the resource type hierarchy

local_context.required_background: Avoid a rigid filename formula. Use one plain GET + html example and one selector example only as candidate evidence. Emphasize that multiple candidates may exist and resolution chooses the closest specific match.

layout.composition: A candidate-resolution board: request evidence enters from the left, nonmatching candidates are filtered out and one selected handler exits right; an inheritance fallback lane runs below.
layout.intent: Show narrowing and fallback, not a simplistic direct filename lookup.

visual_elements.main_visual: Evidence filters for resource type, selectors, extension and method feeding a selected handler.

constraints: Render the eyebrow exactly as '06 · HANDLER RESOLUTION'.
Do not imply that HTTP method belongs to RequestPathInfo.
Do not claim every request resolves to HTL; scripts and servlets are both valid handlers.

slides.title: Follow one Sling request with evidence.
slides.intent: Apply the complete evidence chain to one direct component request without requiring a live demonstration.
key_points: GET /content/wknd/us/en/guide/jcr:content/root/container/guide.html
Resolved Resource without .html
No selectors; extension html; no suffix; method GET
sling:resourceType = wknd/components/guide
/apps/wknd/components/guide → guide.html → HTML response

slides.title: Key takeaways
slides.intent: Consolidate the five evidence checkpoints before questions.
key_points: Resolve the Resource before selecting rendering code
Decompose the URL after identifying the resource path
Use sling:resourceType and sling:resourceSuperType to follow capability
Use selectors, extension and method to explain handler selection
Attach observable evidence to every transition

local_context.required_background: Use exact canonical terms and connect every takeaway to one link in the request-resolution chain. Do not introduce dispatcher, caching or deployment concepts.

layout.intent: Retrieve the complete model in the same order used during diagnosis.

constraints: Render the eyebrow exactly as '08 · KEY TAKEAWAYS'.

slides.title: Questions
slides.intent: Close with three retrieval questions and no live-demo or assignment dependency.
key_points: Which checkpoint is still unclear?
Which request value would you inspect first?
Where could resolution fall back to inherited behavior?
